arguments.text: Documentation versus code differences, with my view of which is right. (a) frsr.R says the data-frame recycling takes place "here in R, with explicit rules", but the code only calls data.frame(), which applies R's default recycling; there is no explicit rule in the R code. I believe the code. (b) frsr_bin's Rd says the threads fallback is the "package's compiled default thread count"; the code uses RcppParallel::defaultNumThreads(), a runtime value. I believe the code (see item 17). (c) RcppExports.R and frsr.R both define an R function named frsr; RcppExports.R sorts before frsr.R, so the frsr.R definition should be the one in the namespace. I am inferring this from file order and did not execute it. (d) The Rd for frsr_sample describes the error column as "Absolute relative error of the final result", while frsr's Rd describes it as the double-precision error against the float32-rounded input. These describe the same column; I see no numerical mismatch.
arguments.label: Doc versus code differences
